title: A variable that is defined but never referenced is not evaluated, so its error is not raised
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", VAR Err = ERROR ( "not evaluated" ) VAR n = [Order Count] RETURN n )

source.quote: If the variable is defined but not referenced, then it is not evaluated.
source.supports: the article shows a measure with an unreferenced ERROR variable returning its result

derivation: Err is never referenced, so ERROR is not evaluated. n is COUNTROWS ( Sales ) = 7.
